scope: Full current external media store tests
assessment: Persisted immutable bytes independently retrieved after original source deletion and store restart
Missing or corrupt exact object never falls back; foreign backend and URL locator refused
Repeated persistence stable; restoration never overwrites owned destination
Destination parent substituted by symlink during copy refuses publication and preserves unknown owner file during cleanup
Managed missing CAS restored without artifact metadata changes; actual public CLI persistence/restoration verifies history
limitations: Disposable local backend and fixture bytes; not real long-term media backend acceptance
Cross-filesystem and real product retrieval remain separate
